nodes.instruction: Decide the change-window branch on the computed state. Read answers.risk_score and set answers kind='branch' to 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' if risk_score >= 100, else 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' if risk_score >= 20, else 'NORMAL_WINDOW'. Check the higher tier first; the bands do not overlap. What the route decides is the ESCORT around the window, not its dates: the change window itself is the standing quarterly maintenance slot the release calendar publishes a quarter ahead — same slot, same 3-day duration, on every route, because the slot is negotiated with the business and the desk does not move it. The route decides who works it: 'NORMAL_WINDOW' is worked unescorted; 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' stands up the rollback partner, briefs them before the window and holds the change log behind that briefing; 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' does both and additionally files the '[CM-EMERGENCY]' freeze note on the CAB record.

On the NORMAL_WINDOW branch the log may proceed immediately.

verifier.name: crm_logged_release_total_gated_by_branch
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE lower(customer_email)='cab.lead@atlas.com' AND c.notes LIKE '%[CM-LOG]%' AND c.notes LIKE '%'||(SELECT value FROM answers WHERE kind='release_total')||'%' AND (((SELECT value FROM answers WHERE kind='branch') IN ('EXTENDED_WINDOW','EMERGENCY_HOLD') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gm_emails e WHERE e.sender_id=(SELECT id FROM gm_users WHERE lower(email)='parker.li@atlas.com') AND e.recipient_ids LIKE '%'||(SELECT id FROM gm_users WHERE lower(email)='rollback.partner@atlas.com')||'%' AND e.subject LIKE '%[CM-HANDOFF]%'))  OR ((SELECT value FROM answers WHERE kind='branch')='NORMAL_WINDOW'))) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='branch' AND (value=((CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 100 THEN 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 20 THEN 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' ELSE 'NORMAL_WINDOW' END)) OR (typeof(((CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 100 THEN 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 20 THEN 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' ELSE 'NORMAL_WINDOW' END))) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST(((CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 100 THEN 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 20 THEN 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' ELSE 'NORMAL_WINDOW' END)) AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST(((CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 100 THEN 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 20 THEN 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' ELSE 'NORMAL_WINDOW' END)) AS REAL)))))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='release_total' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nodes.context: Allocate the release_total across the release desk and the co-approver (50/50) on the intercompany change-cost ledger.
nodes.instruction: Post the intercompany change-cost ALLOCATION on the sw_* cost-share ledger. INSERT a sw_expenses row paid by the release desk (parker.li@atlas.com) for the full release_total with description '[CM-ALLOC]', and a sw_expense_shares row assigning the co-approver (morgan.reyes@atlas.com) a share_amount = release_total/2 (its half of the joint change carry).

verifier.name: allocation_and_share_recorded
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sw_expenses e JOIN sw_expense_shares s ON s.expense_id=e.id WHERE e.payer_id=(SELECT id FROM sw_users WHERE lower(email)='parker.li@atlas.com') AND e.description LIKE '%[CM-ALLOC]%' AND e.amount=(SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM answers WHERE kind='release_total') AND s.debtor_id=(SELECT id FROM sw_users WHERE lower(email)='morgan.reyes@atlas.com') AND s.share_amount=(SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM answers WHERE kind='release_total')/2.0) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='release_total' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER)+((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65 AND defensive_work_rate = 'low')*1000))) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

context.type_C: change tier re-derived from the LIVE thrombosis book; never in answers

nodes.instruction: Classify the change TIER. RE-DERIVE it from the live change-risk index: score = round(the inpatient percentage), TIER = 'EMERGENCY_CHANGE' if score >= 100, 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' if score >= 20, else 'STANDARD_CHANGE'. Write it to the CAB lead CRM row's DEDICATED status column (set status='[CM-TIER] <tier>') — only after the follow-up task exists. (The tier is NOT written to answers.)

verifier.name: crm_tier_status_correctly_rederived
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE lower(customer_email)='cab.lead@atlas.com' AND c.status LIKE '%[CM-TIER]%' AND c.status LIKE '%'||(CASE WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 100 THEN 'EMERGENCY_CHANGE' WHEN CAST(ROUND((100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE Admission='+' AND STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'))) AS INTEGER) >= 20 THEN 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' ELSE 'STANDARD_CHANGE' END)||'%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM td_tasks t WHERE t.title LIKE '%[CM-FUP]%' AND t.project_id=(SELECT id FROM td_projects WHERE name='Q1 Change Management Review'))

nodes.context: Raise this cycle's change record on the desk's ITSM change register and map it to the production incident the deployment remediates. The change classification is now on record, and the record is filed AT that classification: its summary line names the change number and the tier, so the tier stamped on the CAB-lead record is the figure the change record carries.

artifacts.A_out: eops change CHG0000026 + its mapping to INC-000057

nodes.instruction: Raise this cycle's CHANGE RECORD on the desk's ITSM change register (per the recording handbook) and map it to the production incident the deployment remediates. File change CHG_026 (CHG0000026) on the register's STANDARD-change template — status new, impact low, risk low, priority low, category other, cab_required false: a standard change is pre-approved, which is what the desk's standing pre-authorization for this cycle means in the register — and restate its summary line by prepending '[CM-CHG] CHG0000026 tier=<tier>' to the short_description, the tier word being the classification re-derived from the live change-risk cohort book, the same one stamped on the CAB-lead record. Then map it to incident INC_057 (INC-000057) as mapping CRM_017. File it only once the CAB lead CRM status carries the '[CM-TIER]' tier stamp whose tier matches that live re-derivation — the record is filed AT that classification, so until it is on record there is nothing to file the change at.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-financial 182): the independent side-exposure figure for the quarterly overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview once the change run's own figures are settled and the close-out is ready to sign, so the quarter's entry records the side-exposure figure as it stood at the sign-off rather than mid-run. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the change registers is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in side exposure — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many male customers who were born between 1974 and 1976 have made a payment on their home in excess of $4000?" (Read it as the book does: count the home-payment transactions — k_symbol 'SIPO', amount over 4000 — on accounts held by male clients born between 1974 and 1976.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_exposure'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last — so nothing later in this change run reads it, and what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one trimmed to look tidy would read as a side-exposure move that never happened.)

overall_query:
Run the quarterly production change-management / release cycle for the release desk. Fix the change-risk index from the source cohort book's own question — for patients born between 1930 and 1940, the percentage that were inpatients (100 * inpatient-count / cohort-count, an inpatient being an Admission of '+'). Set the change risk score as that index rounded to a whole number. Pull the in-scope change count from the cross-book register's own question — among players with an overall rating between 60 and 65, how many have a 'low' defensive work rate — and set the change-window uplift at 1000 per in-scope change. The release total is the risk score plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift. Decide the change-window branch on the risk score — 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' when the score is at least 100, 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' when it is at least 20, 'NORMAL_WINDOW' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the change window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar — it is the standing quarterly maintenance slot the release calendar publishes ahead of the cycle, so it goes down unchanged on every route; what the route decides is the escort worked around it, not the slot); post the change-fee disbursement run so the net paid to the correct vendor equals the delta (a disbursement that lands on the wrong vendor is reversed, never deleted, then the correct vendor is paid); unless the branch is NORMAL, send the rollback partner the handoff email citing the release total and the delta; log the release total on the CAB-lead record and open the follow-up; allocate the change carry evenly with the co-approver; RE-DERIVE the change tier from the live cohort index (EMERGENCY_CHANGE when the rounded score is at least 100, EXTENDED_REVIEW when at least 20, else STANDARD_CHANGE) and stamp it on the CAB-lead record; raise this cycle's standard change record on the enterprise change register and map it to the production incident the deployment remediates, hold that incident against the change, tell its caller of record, and pause its response clock for the window (per the recording handbook); send the CAB lead the status update citing the release total, the tier and the held incident; reconcile the fee ledger to the delta — re-deriving the recorded figure chain (release_total = risk_score + change_volume*1000) before the 'ok' verdict; and schedule the post-implementation review after the window ends, conflict-free. Once those figures are settled, take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview, held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off; nothing in the run reads it, and the overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Also pull the independent side-exposure figure for the quarterly overview — how many home-payment transactions (k_symbol 'SIPO', amount over 4000) were made on accounts held by male clients born between 1974 and 1976.
DELIVERABLE. When the engagement is complete, end your final message with a plain-text report block in exactly this form, one line per item:
REPORT
risk_index: the change-risk index — the percentage exactly as the source book returns it (its full decimal form)
risk_score: the change risk score — whole number
change_volume: the in-scope change count — whole number
